purpose: Bookkeeping-only successor clarification of what the C3XA decision does and does NOT authorize. This does NOT rewrite C3XA history; results/c3xa/c3xa_decision.json is preserved unchanged and remains the authoritative C3XA record.
reason: DIR natural imagery failed the prospective reliability gate; artificial shapes qualified only for a restricted stimulus family.

clarification_detail.what_c3xa_qualified: Only the restricted artificial-shape imagery family on DIR/ds001506 (2/3 subjects reliable), as a clearly-labelled RESTRICTED replication family.
clarification_detail.what_c3xa_did_NOT_qualify: Natural-image imagery on DIR (0/3 subjects passed the conservative gate; every subject's natural bootstrap CI included 0). No broad natural-image perception->imagery geometry claim is authorized by DIR.
clarification_detail.primary_C3XR_family_field_in_c3xa_decisi: artificial_15 -- this names the ONLY family that qualified; it does NOT constitute general C3XR authorization, and does NOT authorize natural-image or exact-image geometry.
clarification_detail.effect_on_C3XB: C3XB independently screens a DIFFERENT dataset (GOD/ds001246) for natural-object CATEGORY imagery reliability. C3XB does not rely on and is not authorized by the C3XA artificial-shape qualification.
